title: Words for an erase the record write did not take, after the chat step ran: the web says nothing of the chat, the iPhone gives the wrong reason
evidence: Partial 2026-11-26 (US-11 AC13; Brad 2026-11-26: 'use your judement for the sentences. must be succinct, and I approve whatever sentences you suggest'). One table, packages/health-core/src/erase-outcome.ts eraseOutcomeWords, keyed by the record step (erased, not-saved, failed with its own words) and the chat step (erased, unreached, unread, or not run). The web reads it (widget-src/src/hooks/useErase.ts; deleteUserData answers chat). A put-back after the chat step says 'Your health record was not deleted: the erase could not be saved.' then 'Your chat history was deleted.', 'Your chat history could not be reached just now.' or the chat-history.json sentence, then 'Try again.'; an erase that stopped with its own words after the chat step adds the chat step's sentence. Left: the iPhone, lead S58a. Tests: packages/health-core/src/erase-outcome.test.ts, widget-src/src/hooks/useErase.test.tsx. US-11 AC2c, AC3b, AC13; US-25 AC16
